title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: select_channel returns invalid channel index when n_channels < 3
description:
The expression `n = max(n_channels - 1, 2)` clamps n to minimum 2, but this produces out-of-range channel indices for small n_channels values. When n_channels=2 (channels 0,1 exist), the function can return channel 2. When n_channels=1 (only channel 0), it can return 1 or 2. Both are invalid channel indices.

Fix suggestion: Either validate that n_channels >= 3 at function entry, or change the logic to clamp the return value to valid range: `return 1 + (h % max(n_channels - 1, 1))`
close_reason: Not a bug - spec mandates N = MAX(NChannels, 3), so returning channels > n_channels for n_channels<3 is correct per spec
